Prerequisites: Warrior 6

The warrior can react to danger before his senses would normally allow him to do so. He cannot be caught flat-footed, even if the attacker is invisible. He still loses his Dexterity bonus to AC if immobilized. A warrior with this ability can still lose his Dexterity bonus to AC if an opponent successfully uses the feint action against him. If a warrior already has uncanny dodge from a different class, he automatically gains improved uncanny dodge (see below) instead.
